text:
marta: Noticed anomaly in tonight's invoice run for customer 'Lumenix' (cust_559). Two invoices created: inv_236000A = $7,420 and inv_236000B = $6,800. Second one missing 'LD Service Charge' $620. Job run: bill-2026-05-02-22. @billing-team

billing-bot: automated retry detected for job bill-2026-05-02-22; created inv_236000B as retry record.

ben: quick DB check: ```SELECT id, amount_cents, line_items, metadata->>'run' FROM invoices WHERE customer_id='cust_559' AND created_at > '2026-05-02';```
Result:
- inv_236000A | 742000 | [{usage:680000,ld_service:62000}] | run=run-9121
- inv_236000B | 680000 | [{usage:680000}]           | run=run-9121-retry

kevin: logs show pdf-generator timed out on first attempt; retry path creates new invoice row and skips optional attach step because `if already_attached_by(job_run): return` returns true erroneously when job_run differs. File: billing/worker/line_attach.py:56

marta: Any payments captured? Customer already pinged support about lower amount.

billing-bot: payment status: uncaptured for both invoices. No refunds.

ben: Proposed actions: 1) pause exporter for run-9121; 2) void inv_236000B with note 'duplicate from retry; missing LD service charge SPT-1722'; 3) reissue inv_236000C with full lines. Need accounting sign-off.

kevin: Opening hotfix: make attach operation idempotent (upsert by invoice_id and code) and add unique constraint on invoice_lines(code, invoice_id). Also change retry to reuse invoice id when possible.

ops: exporter paused for run-9121 and ENG-BILL-988 created.

marta: I approve void (no capture). Ben please set note and run void after 10m so support can hold customer reply.

ben: Will run SQL after 10m: ```UPDATE invoices SET status='voided', note='duplicate: retry omitted LD service charge; see SPT-1722' WHERE id='inv_236000B';```

kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/481 - idempotency + unique constraint. Staging deploy scheduled in 30m.

marta: Thanks all. Adding to month-end audit and customer message draft: "Hi Lumenix — we found an automated billing retry created a duplicate invoice missing a small service charge. We'll void the duplicate and reissue the correct invoice today. No action required." :thumbsup:
